---
name: Defect
about: Anything that went wrong (bug, review error, broken check, incident, retro finding). See the root-cause-fix skill.
labels: defect
---
## Symptom (evidence)
<!-- One sentence, with evidence: file, commit, log line. -->

## Proximate cause
<!-- What went wrong. -->

## Enabling cause
<!-- Why nothing stopped it: the missing rule, check, document or default. -->

## Cause fix
<!-- The change to the rule, document, template, default or structure. Not only the failed code path. -->

## Check (script or `judgment:<agent>`)
<!-- scripts/<name>.sh wired into verify.sh, or the reviewer agent that owns it. -->

## Verified
<!-- The check failed on the original symptom, then passed. Paste both outputs. -->
